params.name: inputTemplate
params.description: Data containing 4D transformation tags to process.

overloads.semanticRole: The PROCESS 4D TAGS command causes the processing of 4D transformation tags contained in the inputTemplate parameter while (optionally) inserting value(s) using the param parameters and returns the result in outputResult

constraints: inputTemplate can contain any tag-based text (4DTEXT, 4DHTML, 4DSCRIPT, etc.), not just HTML.
Optional param values are inserted into the template's tags/expressions during processing; a full description of the tag grammar is in the 4D Transformation Tags section.
